evaluation_type: fixed development comparison on previously observed conditions; not an independent holdout
purpose: Test whether an operator-sensitive two-state disagreement diagnostic can target a conservative fallback more efficiently than universal fallback or equal-cost extra time points.

base_selector.choice_rule: minimum predicted cost among eligible PFs; abstain if none

state_pair.fine_state: normalized full CISD state stored in the hash-validated H01 pickle
state_pair.coarse_state: deterministic coefficient-truncated version of the same full CISD vector
state_pair.construction: Sort coefficients by descending absolute magnitude with restricted-basis index as the stable tie-break; retain the shortest prefix whose squared norm reaches 0.99; renormalize; do not use H, exact state, overlap, energy, gap, or truth.
state_pair.interpretation: A local CISD-tail stability diagnostic, not a rigorous state-error bound and not proof of convergence to the exact ground state.

universal_fallback.formula_choice: minimum predicted cost after capping every PF at 0.5 full-CISD t_ana

state_targeted_fallback.formula_choice: minimum predicted cost after applying the 0.5 t_ana cap when either the original fallback or state-risk flag is true

equal_cost_extra_points.formula_choice: base selector with a seven-point full-CISD fit and the original fallback

resource_accounting.quantum_cost_metric: Pauli rotations using the existing expanded-and-adjacent-merged PF sequence
resource_accounting.do_not_combine: Do not add classical seconds and Pauli rotations without a preregistered conversion.

phase_a.bug_policy: Preserve the run as INVALIDATED_RUN and create a new protocol version.

phase_b.truth_policy: Open direct truth only after Phase-A predictions are committed and hash-frozen.
phase_b.anchor_policy: For each condition/formula, select a lower reliable H01-native point with required provenance, recompute it from the same H01 pickle, then track continuously through sorted inserted times.
phase_b.reference_regret: exact selected-time direct cost divided by the original two-PF saved-grid minimum cost minus one
phase_b.expanded_reference: Report separately after adding inserted points; never replace the primary reference.

primary_metrics: gamma=1.01 safety by condition and strategy
original-grid joint regret by condition and strategy
classical wall time, memory, and proxy-action count

inconclusive_if: any source or numerical gate fails
any of the six conditions lacks exact-time scoring
decision.minimum_safety: state_targeted_fallback has zero unsafe executions at gamma=1.01 and primary coverage 4/4
decision.efficiency_gain: mean original-grid joint regret across six conditions is at least 10% relatively lower than practical_baseline, and no condition regret increases by more than 0.10 absolute
decision.diagnostic_specificity: state_targeted_fallback beats universal_fallback or equal_cost_extra_points by at least 5% relatively in mean regret or 10% relatively in maximum regret
decision.outcome_benefit: minimum_safety and efficiency_gain and diagnostic_specificity all hold
decision.outcome_no_benefit: all gates pass but outcome_benefit is false
decision.next_step_if_benefit: Freeze one S5 unused-active-space molecular evaluation; do not tune on it.
decision.next_step_if_no_benefit: Do not add diagnostics post hoc; complete the mechanism-centered study.

scope_limits: Development comparison on previously observed molecules and truth; not an independent holdout.
The truncated/full CISD disagreement is not a rigorous upper bound on exact-state substitution error.
The four extra coarse-state actions are counted even if cached or vectorized.
No new PF coefficients, molecule, basis, target precision, or error-model powers may be introduced.
S5 is forbidden unless the frozen S4 benefit outcome is met.
